contract: Worker-protocol flat child-only all barriers authored and cold-replayed by the real published PHP SDK: every child starts atomically, carries the original call/link/instance/run and path, and returns exact ordered typed results despite out-of-order completion. Success waits for every member; failure/cancel/terminate wakes the parent immediately as ChildWorkflowFailed. Duplicate parent/child completions add no starts or history. After a failed parent catches its outcome and closes under default abandon, later successful siblings add no parent resolution or wakeup. This worker-HTTP side contract is explicitly inapplicable to embedded execution. Native cold database replacement, retries/continuation, malformed and unqualified shape refusals, bounded inventory and rollback are covered separately by cross-backend native tests. Child select/nested/mixed/scoped/started-in-all remain refused.

failure_messages.cancelled: Workflow cancelled: child barrier closed λ
failure_messages.terminated: Workflow terminated: child barrier closed λ
